name: Make a wiki article
description: Research a topic and prepare a sourced article for OpenVibe.Wiki.
instructions: Ask the person for the topic if they have not given one. Read multiple reliable sources and note their dates. Draft a neutral article with a clear title, short introduction, sections, and citations beside the claims they support. Check that every link opens and supports the sentence. Place the article in OpenVibe.Wiki as a draft for the person to review; do not publish it without their approval.
